caption:
A company built a tiny drone that hunts down mosquitoes and kills them, no chemicals needed.

It's called Tornyol. A small flying robot designed to find and kill mosquitoes on its own. Mosquitoes kill over 700,000 people a year, more than any other animal on Earth. If a little drone can do what bug spray never could, this could save thousands of lives in places where malaria and dengue hit hardest.
